desktop.rightClick: Remove one point when dependencies remain legal; context menu suppressed
desktop.keyboard: Enter or Space adds; Backspace or Delete removes
desktop.tooltip: Shown on mouse enter or keyboard focus; hidden on leave or blur, refreshed after rank change

interactionNotes.gates: Every 5 points in earlier tree rows opens a row; maxed named prerequisite required. Removal is blocked if another spent talent would become illegal.
interactionNotes.arrows: SVG arrows use actual cell centers and turn gold when the named prerequisite is maxed. The source omits a line that would run through another talent, including the current Precision to Dual Wield Specialization connection; the tooltip and validation still enforce that prerequisite.
interactionNotes.visual: 44x44 icons on 4-column, 7-row grids; lower-right rank overlays; locked grayscale and brightness .55; available and partial green; maxed gold; tree background center/cover with dark vertical gradient.

verification.browserLimit: In-app browser was unavailable for this agent at verification time.

publicationNote: Public provenance retains source URLs, relative asset paths, dimensions, checksums, credits and descriptive reference behavior. Local computer paths and copied source-code excerpts are omitted.
